map.输入电阻 R 与电容 C，按 f_c = 1/(2π·R·C) 计算一阶 RC: Enter resistance R and capacitance C, then compute the -3dB cutoff of a first-order RC low-pass or high-pass filter with f_c = 1/(2*pi*R*C), for audio and signal filtering circuit design.
map.一阶 RC 低通/高通滤波器的 −3dB 转折频率。: The -3dB transition frequency of a first-order RC low-pass or high-pass filter.
map.电阻 R 与电容 C 求 −3dB 截止 fc = 1/(2πRC)。: For resistance R and capacitance C, the -3dB cutoff is fc = 1/(2*pi*R*C).
map.对比不同 R、C 的转折频率。: Compare the corner frequencies of different R and C values.
map.：若 C=0.1µF，则 fc≈1591.5Hz，电容变小截止频率上移十倍。: If C = 0.1uF, then fc = about 1591.5Hz; a smaller capacitance moves the cutoff frequency up tenfold.
map.由有效值与负载求功率: Power from RMS value and load
map.由信号功率与噪声功率求信噪比: Signal-to-Noise Ratio from Signal Power and Noise Power
map.阶跃稳态误差（e_ss = 1 / (1 + K_p)）: Steady-state error of a step response (e_ss = 1 / (1 + K_p))
map.截止频率是增益为 0 吗？: Is the Cutoff Frequency Where the Gain Is 0?
map.不是，是 −3dB（幅度降为 1/√2、功率降一半）处，即半功率点。: No, it is at -3dB (amplitude down to 1/sqrt(2), power halved), the half-power point.
map.R、C 谁对 fc 影响大？: Which One Affects f_c More, R or C?
map.fc 与 R、C 均成反比，任一减半 fc 翻倍。: f_c is inversely proportional to both R and C; halving either one doubles f_c.
